title: Another raw original of Borealis altered keeping size and time

raw-2002-tampered.text: BOREALIS raw IMG_2002 synthetic sensor dataY

case.facts: Project Borealis: raw/IMG_2002.ARW now has a different digest while its size and modification time are unchanged; raw/IMG_2001.ARW has no copy outside Volume 1.
case.expected_text: IMG_2002 is reported as altered; IMG_2001 is reported as at risk.
